title: One Sentry and Impact preview with material targets
context: Owner identified outdated Quiver and Heptapod animations in the separate Impact lab and requested a combined range with Waves, Pop, Wall, Armour and Hull targets.
outcome: The Sentry range now owns the sole firing preview and complete working FX package. A separate effects-panel module edits each selected weapon, and the game impact factories draw muzzle/arrival recipes. DART Swift/Hook timing is shared for all targets. Wall/Armour/Hull are persistent material fixtures with surface-normal contacts; Waves/Pop retain enemy behavior. Effects are bounded to 128 groups. Legacy #impact links normalize before content/route consumers load, retaining family and draft; the old controller is a compatibility export. One menu entry and transfer panel remain. The tank Beam lab stays separate. Old Impact-only curvature is retired pending a shared sphere-stage contract.
alternatives: Keeping a second missile preview or merely renaming its menu would preserve the animation drift.
Initial expanded effects controls obscured range-label hover targets; detailed folders now start collapsed.
The original overhead camera hid fixed targets below the transfer panel; material modes now frame both ends of the firing lane from the side.
evidence: npm test: 69 programs passed, including pinned MORK rig and material contact/normal tests.
npm run check: canonical modules, 19 pure-layer boundaries, pinned assets/kernel, presets and logs passed.

npm run test:browser: source acceptance passed, including material modes, both missile durations, live effect-size edits, shared FX/missile draft persistence, legacy Impact routing and MORK movement/lift/recoil.

node scripts/browser-test.mjs --dist: full nested-release acceptance passed, including MORK, combined material targets, both missiles, live profile edits, radial/help controls, draft transfer and service-worker installation.
